name: MediaTools
overview: Media management swiss army knife: zero-interruption renaming, split-movie merging, MKV remuxing and stream deduplication.
description: Comprehensive media optimization tool for Jellyfin: intelligently cleans release filenames without SQLite foreign-key breaks, merges multi-part CD1/CD2 movies via FFmpeg concat, batch remuxes legacy containers into MKV with subtitles, and detects byte-accurate audio/video duplicates.
